worldcombat.skill.lowkick.summary: A fast low sweep at the supporting leg: the heavier the target, the harder it is to pull its balance back and the harder it falls. It is a close, quick and cheap kick that leaves nothing on the ground; a target with both feet off the ground is only glanced for half damage. The reaping form carries the kick into a short arc ahead and to the side, taking down a second foe it can see from the point of contact; anyone behind it or across a wall is missed.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.use.0: Sweep a heavy target off its feet at close range
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.use.1: Cut a leg out from under a charging foe
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.use.2: A cheap fast kick against a heavy, hard-hitting foe
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.description.0: The sweep deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; heavier targets take more.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.description.1: Lunge up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, sweeping the first living body you touch.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.description.2: A swept target cannot move for about %2$s (though it can still act) and stays off balance for about %3$s (movement speed 50%% lower); it loses %1$s Speed stages (Pokemon drop Speed stages, other combatants lose movement speed), and that stage drop does not come back when the off-balance state ends. An airborne target only takes half damage and is not tripped.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.reap.on: Reaping form: a longer lunge that, after landing on the primary target, carries the kick into a %1$s block arc ahead and to the side, taking down one more foe it can see within about 150 degrees of the point of contact; anyone behind it or across a wall is missed. Slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.reap.off: Point-kick form: a single, heavier and faster sweep.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.timing: Reach within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.growth.0: At level %1$s, the sweep power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.growth.1: At level %1$s, the sweep power rises to %2$s and the lunge to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.lowkick.preference.rea: On: a longer lunge that carries the kick into a short arc ahead and to the side, taking down a second foe it can see within about 150 degrees of the point of contact (never one behind it or across a wall); but slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a single, heavier and faster sweep.
